rules.title: PHP unserialize
rules.description: PHP unserialize on untrusted input instantiates arbitrary classes and runs their magic methods.

input.subject: trace
input.question: The marked call turns serialized data into objects. Where does the data that the call reads come from?

options.untrusted-input: the data comes from the network, from a file the user did not write, or from an argument or an environment variable set outside the skill.
options.own-data: the data is something the skill wrote itself, a file bundled with the skill, or a constant.
options.safe-method: the call is a safe variant that builds only plain values or the classes it lists.
options.not-a-match: the marked text is not a call that turns serialized data into objects.
options.unknown: the state does not show where the data comes from.
